title: APackByRandomGuy (ABGF)
description: Experience a masterfully curated blend of technical engineering, RPG progression, and epic exploration featuring overhauled structures, legendary weapons, and formidable bosses. This non-profit community project includes server-side files.
body:
This modpack is a carefully curated blend of technical engineering, RPG depth, and a world that practically begs to be explored.

**Overhauled Classics:** Explore completely redesigned Fortresses, Mineshafts, and Temples thanks to the full YUNG’s suite.

**Monumental Dangers:** Face the gargantuan fortresses of When Dungeons Arise and navigate the deadly traps of Repurposed Structures.

**New Horizons:** Journey through the mystical Twilight Forest or master the stars with Stargate Journey.

**RPG Progression:** Collect powerful gear affixes and use Apothic Enchanting to push your equipment far beyond standard limits.

**Epic Bosses:** Prepare yourself before challenging the monstrosities of L_Ender's Cataclysm—they will demand everything from you.

**The Arsenal:** Choose from legendary blades by DarkBlades, homing magic staffs, or the mechanical gadgets of Create Stuff 'N Additions.

**There is a lot more you can discover...**

If you like to **host this Modpack with your own hardware**, you´re able to download also a Serverpack for each Modpackversion.

This pack is a curated collection of work created by the incredible Minecraft modding community. I did not develop these mods; I simply hand-picked and configured them to work perfectly together with my preferences.
Because this is a community-driven project, this pack is 100% non-profit. If you enjoy the experience, please go and check out the individual mod pages to support the original developers.

If you have questions or wan´t to see some mods within this modpack, feel free to contact me via the Commentssection or write an E-Mail to business@derblindemann.de.
